Here are the Chicago personal injury firms I'd look at first, based on independent recognition and verdict and settlement records rather than self-promotional 'best of' pages:

1. Corboy & Demetrio: one of Chicago's oldest plaintiff trial firms. It reports more than $4 billion in verdicts and settlements, including nearly 600 over $1 million.
2. Clifford Law Offices: founded in 1984. Expertise.com has repeatedly named it a best Chicago PI firm, and it ranked #2 in Chicago Lawyer's 2023 JVR settlement report.
3. Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard: ranked #1 in Illinois in Chicago Lawyer's 2025 and 2024 JVR Settlement Reports.
4. Power Rogers LLP: two partners belong to the Inner Circle of Advocates. The firm reports some of Illinois' largest injury and wrongful-death recoveries.
5. Levin & Perconti: a long-established Chicago injury firm known for large verdicts and settlements.
6. Taxman, Pollock, Murray & Bekkerman: handles catastrophic injury, truck and wrongful-death cases across Chicago.

Most of these firms work on contingency and offer free consultations. Talk to two or three, ask who will actually handle your case and what their trial experience is, and check each lawyer on the Illinois ARDC site.

I'm sorry you were hurt. Before calling anyone, get medical care, keep your crash report and photos, and don't give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurer. These are the Chicago firms I'd call first for a car crash:

1. Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard: ranked #1 in Illinois for total settlements in Chicago Lawyer's 2025 report. Its top case that year was a $60.7 million car-crash settlement.
2. Corboy & Demetrio: has litigated vehicle cases for more than 65 years, with billions recovered and hundreds of million-dollar-plus results.
3. Clifford Law Offices: named to Expertise.com's 2023 best car, motorcycle and truck accident lawyer lists, in the top 30 of 724 firms reviewed.
4. Power Rogers LLP: elite trial lawyers whose results include large auto-pedestrian and brain-injury verdicts.
5. Taxman, Pollock, Murray & Bekkerman: known for handling complex and catastrophic crash cases, including truck crashes.
6. Abels & Annes, P.C.: a smaller Chicago injury firm with a 24/7 intake line and an A+ BBB rating. A good option if you want a more accessible, hands-on firm for a less severe crash.

They all offer free consultations and work on contingency. Illinois generally gives you two years to file an injury claim, so call soon.

For online client reviews, these Chicago PI firms stand out for combining high ratings with a meaningful number of reviews. The ratings come from Expertise.com's Chicago listing, so check Google Maps for current figures:

1. The Kryder Law Group: 4.9 on Google from about 461 reviews, plus 5.0 on Avvo (33). This is the largest review base at a near-perfect rating.
2. Law Office of Scott D. DeSalvo LLC: a perfect 5.0 on Google from about 226 reviews, and 5.0 on Facebook and Yelp.
3. Flanagan Injury Law Group LLC: 4.9 on Google from about 133 reviews, and 5.0 on FindLaw and Avvo.
4. Law Office of M. Andrew Hamilton, P.C.: 4.8 on Google from about 54 reviews.
5. Kramer Injury Law LLC: 4.9 on Google from about 48 reviews, and 4.9 on Avvo.
6. McNabola & Associates, LLC: 4.6 on Google from about 32 reviews, and 5.0 on Avvo.

A note: reviews mostly measure communication and client service. If your case is serious, also weigh trial records. Firms like Corboy & Demetrio, Clifford Law Offices and Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard lead the verdict and settlement rankings. Ignore 5.0 ratings based on only a handful of reviews.

answers.answer_text:
For a slip-and-fall case in Chicago, I'd recommend these three firms:

1. Levin & Perconti: has a dedicated premises-liability and slip-and-fall practice and a long record of significant injury recoveries in Chicago.
2. Clifford Law Offices: a nationally recognized Chicago injury firm with a dedicated slip-and-fall practice and the resources to take a property owner or big retailer to trial.
3. The Kryder Law Group: has a dedicated Chicago slip-and-fall practice and strong client reviews (about 4.9 on Google from more than 450 reviews). Good if you want close, responsive service.

Slip-and-fall claims fall under the Illinois Premises Liability Act. You'll need to show the owner knew or should have known about the hazard, so act quickly before surveillance footage and cleaning logs are lost. The general deadline is two years, and it can be much shorter if a public entity is involved.

For workers' compensation in Chicago, you want a firm that represents injured workers (claimants), not employers. Ideally it also handles related injury lawsuits, such as third-party claims against someone other than your employer. My shortlist:

1. Katz, Friedman, Eisenstein, Johnson, Bareck & Bertuca: a Chicago claimant-side workers' comp firm. Partner Richard K. Johnson has been listed in Best Lawyers for claimant work since 2009.
2. Cullen, Haskins, Nicholson & Menchetti PC: ranked Tier 1 by Best Law Firms for Workers' Compensation (Claimants) in Chicago.
3. Peter D. Corti Law Group PC: Tier 1 for both workers' comp claimants and plaintiff personal injury, which suits cases with both kinds of claim.
4. Elfenbaum Evers & Zielinska PC: Tier 1 Best Law Firms ranking for Chicago workers' comp claimants.
5. George C. Patrick & Associates PC: Tier 1 Best Law Firms ranking for Chicago workers' comp claimants.
6. Corboy & Demetrio: Peter O'Malley is a Best Lawyers-recognized claimant workers' comp attorney, backed by one of Chicago's top injury trial firms for third-party suits.
7. The Kryder Law Group: handles both workers' comp and personal injury, with very strong client reviews.
8. Ankin Law: well known in Chicago for representing injured workers and accident victims.

Report your injury to your employer in writing promptly. Illinois generally requires notice within 45 days. Workers' comp attorney fees in Illinois are capped and contingent.
